floors.name: Ground floor
floors.description: Enter through the marked conference entrance beside registration. The registration desk is next to the stairs down to Main Hall (Aula Magna) on Level −1.

places.name: Entrance
places.description: Conference arrival entrance on the ground floor, opening into the registration area beside the Aula Magna stairs.

places.name: Registration
places.description: Conference registration desk inside the ground-floor entrance, alongside the stairs leading down to Main Hall (Aula Magna).

places.name: Foyer - 0
places.description: The open ground-floor foyer in front of the Aula Magna volume.

places.name: Main stairs
places.description: Main staircase along the upper edge of the foyer.

places.name: Aula Magna stairs
places.description: The long flights beside the Aula Magna volume. They connect Ground with Level −1.

places.name: Aula Magna lift
places.description: The lift behind the Aula Magna, beside a return staircase. The same shaft is shown on all three mapped floors.

places.name: Toilets
places.description: Toilets in the service core below the central opening.

places.name: Foyer lift core
places.description: The lift at the left end of the compact foyer core, beside the small staircase and toilet cubicles.

places.name: Foyer stairs
places.description: The small return staircase in the foyer core. It connects Ground, Level −1 and Level −2.

floors.name: Level −1
floors.description: Main Hall (Aula Magna) opens onto the exhibition area, with four stands in front of it. Catering is in the central foyer; the press room and work area are along the left-hand side.

places.name: Main Hall
places.description: Aula Magna, called Main Hall in the conference programme. The large auditorium on the left of this floor opens onto the foyer.

places.name: Foyer - 1
places.description: The foyer in front of Main Hall includes the exhibition area and continues towards catering in the central open space.

places.name: Exhibition area
places.description: Exhibition area in front of the Main Hall entrance. Four exhibition stands, numbered 1–4, run along the lower edge of the foyer.

places.name: Catering area
places.description: Catering area in the central open foyer, to the right of the exhibition area and the Aula Magna stair and lift core.

places.name: Press room
places.description: Press room on the left-hand side of the exhibition area, beside the Main Hall foyer.

places.name: Work area
places.description: Workstations with tables and power sockets for charging, along the left-hand side of the Main Hall foyer.

places.name: Main stairs
places.description: Main staircase along the upper edge of the foyer.

places.name: Central stairs
places.description: Central staircase above the toilet service core.

places.name: Aula Magna lift
places.description: The lift behind the Aula Magna, beside a return staircase. The same shaft is shown on all three mapped floors.

places.name: Toilets
places.description: Toilets in the service core below the broad centre-right stair.

places.name: Foyer lift core
places.description: The lift at the left end of the compact foyer core, beside the small staircase and toilet cubicles.

places.name: Aula Magna stairs
places.description: The long flights beside the Aula Magna. These stairs lead up to Ground.

places.name: Stairs beside toilets
places.description: The narrow staircase beside the central toilet block. It connects Level −1 and Level −2.

places.name: Foyer stairs
places.description: The small return staircase in the foyer core. It connects Ground, Level −1 and Level −2.

floors.summary: Main Hall · Exhibition area · Catering area · Foyer - 1

notes.label: Work and recharge
notes.text: Tables and charging sockets are available in the work area beside the exhibition space.

floors.overviewNote: E = Exhibition area · C = Catering area · F1 = Foyer - 1 · Stands 1–4.

floors.name: Level −2
floors.description: The poster area occupies the central foyer. Workshop rooms AS03, AS02 and AS01 run from top to bottom on the right.

places.name: AS01
places.description: Workshop classroom. The lower room in the group of three on the right. Its doors face the corridor on the left.

places.name: AS02
places.description: Workshop classroom. The middle room in the group of three on the right, between AS01 and AS03.

places.name: AS03
places.description: Workshop classroom. The upper room in the group of three on the right, at the upper end of the corridor.

places.name: Poster area
places.description: Conference poster area in the central foyer, between the foyer lift core and workshop rooms AS01–AS03.

places.name: Main stairs
places.description: The short straight flight along the upper edge of the foyer, above the poster area.

places.name: Central stairs
places.description: Central staircase above the toilet service core.

places.name: Aula Magna lift
places.description: The lift behind the Aula Magna, beside a return staircase. The same shaft is shown on all three mapped floors.

places.name: Toilets
places.description: Toilets in the service core below the broad centre-right stair.

places.name: Foyer lift core
places.description: The lift at the left end of the compact foyer core, beside the small staircase and toilet cubicles.

places.name: Stairs beside toilets
places.description: The narrow staircase beside the central toilet block. It connects Level −1 and Level −2.

places.name: Foyer stairs
places.description: The small return staircase in the foyer core. It connects Ground, Level −1 and Level −2.

notes.label: Workshop rooms
notes.text: AS01–AS03 are the workshop classrooms. Programme Rooms 1, 2 and 3 correspond to AS01, AS02 and AS03.
